# QS-CFW-4376-34 Quality specification - valve body CFW-4376-34 (F316)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-4376-34

Scope
This quality specification defines the material and dimensional acceptance criteria for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) manufactured at Plant P3. It applies to finished forgings prior to machining and to parts after final heat treatment as noted in manufacturing instructions.

Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness (post-heat treatment) | The hardness range for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 31-34 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is ±0.10 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for valve body CFW-4376-34 (CFW-4376-34) is 46.2 kg. |

Inspection method
Hardness shall be measured using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester following manufacturer calibration procedures and company test bench instructions. Readings shall be taken at locations representative of the load-bearing sections and reported as individual values. Bore diameter shall be measured with calibrated bore gauges or internal micrometers capable of resolving the specified tolerance; measurement technique shall ensure alignment and repeatability. Forging weight shall be verified on calibrated industrial scales at the point of initial inspection. All inspection equipment must be within calibration and traceable to company calibration records.

Nonconformance handling
Parts failing to meet any requirement in the table are nonconforming. Nonconforming items shall be segregated and tagged, and a nonconformance report shall be initiated. Disposition options include rework if the process can demonstrably restore compliance, or rejection and return to melting/charge as per production control. Root cause shall be investigated and corrective actions implemented to prevent recurrence. Records of nonconformance, disposition, and corrective action shall be retained in the document control system under the part file for traceability.
